+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Porter stemmer (compact stdlib-only, Martino Tartari port). Inlined so the
+# submission needs no external stemmer module.
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def _con(s, i):
+    ch = s[i]
+    if ch in "aeiou":
+        return 0
+    if ch == "y":
+        return 1 if i == 0 else 0
+    return 1
+
+
+def _has_vowel(s):
+    for i in range(len(s)):
+        if not _con(s, i):
+            return True
+    return False
+
+
+def _m(s):
+    n = 0
+    i = 0
+    L = len(s)
+    while True:
+        while i < L and _con(s, i):
+            i += 1
+        if i >= L:
+            break
+        n += 1
+        while i < L and not _con(s, i):
+            i += 1
+    return n
+
+
+def _doublec(s):
+    return len(s) >= 2 and s[-1] == s[-2] and _con(s, len(s) - 1)
+
+
+def _cvc(s):
+    L = len(s)
+    if L < 3 or not _con(s, L - 1) or _con(s, L - 2) or not _con(s, L - 3):
+        return False
+    if s[L - 1] in "wxy":
+        return False
+    return True
+
+
+def _endsv(s, suf):
+    if not s.endswith(suf):
+        return False
+    return _con(s, len(s) - len(suf) - 1)
+
+
+def _replace(s, suf, rep):
+    return s[:len(s) - len(suf)] + rep
+
+
+def step1a(w):
+    if w.endswith("sses"):
+        return w[:-2]
+    if w.endswith("ies"):
+        return w[:-2]
+    if not w.endswith("ss") and w.endswith("s"):
+        return w[:-1]
+    return w
+
+
+def step1b(w):
+    flag = False
+    if w.endswith("eed"):
+        if _m(w[:-3]) > 0:
+            return w[:-1]
+        return w
+    if w.endswith("ed"):
+        if _has_vowel(w[:-2]):
+            w = w[:-2]
+            flag = True
+    elif w.endswith("ing"):
+        if _has_vowel(w[:-3]):
+            w = w[:-3]
+            flag = True
+    if flag:
+        if w.endswith("at") or w.endswith("bl") or w.endswith("iz"):
+            return w + "e"
+        if _doublec(w) and not (w.endswith("l") or w.endswith("s") or w.endswith("z")):
+            return w[:-1]
+        if _m(w) == 1 and _cvc(w):
+            return w + "e"
+    return w
+
+
+def step1c(w):
+    if w.endswith("y") and _has_vowel(w[:-1]):
+        return w[:-1] + "i"
+    return w
+
+
+def step2(w, pairs):
+    if _m(w) <= 0:
+        return w
+    for suf, rep in pairs:
+        if _endsv(w, suf):
+            return _replace(w, suf, rep)
+    return w
+
+
+def step3(w, pairs):
+    if _m(w) <= 0:
+        return w
+    for suf, rep in pairs:
+        if w.endswith(suf):
+            return _replace(w, suf, rep)
+    return w
+
+
+def step4(w):
+    if _m(w) <= 1:
+        return w
+    for suf in ("alize", "icate", "ical", "ful", "ness", "ent", "ement", "ment",
+                "ion", "ity", "ize", "iti", "ous", "ive", "al"):
+        if w.endswith(suf):
+            if suf == "ion" and len(w) > 3 and w[-4] in "se":
+                return w[:-len(suf)]
+            return w[:-len(suf)]
+    return w
+
+
+def step5a(w):
+    if w.endswith("e"):
+        m = _m(w)
+        if (m > 1) or (m == 1 and not _cvc(w[:-1])):
+            return w[:-1]
+    return w
+
+
+def step5b(w):
+    if _m(w) > 1 and _doublec(w) and w.endswith("l"):
+        return w[:-1]
+    return w
+
+
+S2 = [("ational", "ate"), ("tional", "tion"), ("enci", "ence"), ("anci", "ance"),
+      ("izer", "ize"), ("abli", "able"), ("alli", "al"), ("entli", "ent"),
+      ("eli", "e"), ("ousli", "ous"), ("ization", "ize"), ("ation", "ate"),
+      ("ator", "ate"), ("alism", "al"), ("iveness", "ive"), ("fulness", "ful"),
+      ("ousness", "ous"), ("aliti", "al"), ("iviti", "ive"), ("biliti", "ble")]
+S3 = [("icate", "ic"), ("ative", ""), ("alize", "al"), ("iciti", "ic"),
+      ("ical", "ic"), ("ful", "")]
+
+
+def stem(w):
+    w = w.lower()
+    if len(w) < 3:
+        return w
+    w = step1a(w)
+    w = step1b(w)
+    w = step1c(w)
+    w = step2(w, S2)
+    w = step3(w, S3)
+    w = step4(w)
+    w = step5a(w)
+    w = step5b(w)
+    return w
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# BM25
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def tok(text):
+    out = []
+    for w in TOKEN.findall(text.lower()):
+        if w in STOP:
+            continue
+        if STEM:
+            w = stem(w)
+        if w:
+            out.append(w)
+    return out
+
+
+def build(corpus):
+    N = len(corpus)
+    tfs = []
+    dl = []
+    df = {}
+    for d in corpus:
+        title = d.get("title") or ""
+        text = d.get("text") or ""
+        tf = {}
+        for w in tok(title):
+            tf[w] = tf.get(w, 0) + TB
+        for w in tok(text):
+            tf[w] = tf.get(w, 0) + 1
+        tfs.append(tf)
+        dl.append(sum(tf.values()))
+        for w in tf:
+            df[w] = df.get(w, 0) + 1
+    avgdl = sum(dl) / N if N else 0.0
+    idf = {w: math.log(1.0 + (N - nf + 0.5) / (nf + 0.5)) for w, nf in df.items()}
+    postings = {}
+    for idx, tf in enumerate(tfs):
+        for w, ftf in tf.items():
+            postings.setdefault(w, []).append((idx, ftf))
+    return tfs, dl, idf, postings, avgdl, N
+
+
+def score_query(qtext, idx):
+    tfs, dl, idf, postings, avgdl, N = idx
+    qt = tok(qtext)
+    scores = {}
+    for w in set(qt):
+        idf_w = idf.get(w)
+        if idf_w is None:
+            continue
+        for (idx2, ftf) in postings[w]:
+            dlx = dl[idx2]
+            s = idf_w * (ftf * (K1 + 1.0)) / (ftf + K1 * (1.0 - B + B * dlx / avgdl))
+            scores[idx2] = scores.get(idx2, 0.0) + s
+    return scores
